## Workflow B — Nudge Delivery (Twilio)

Separate Twilio version. The existing Meta Workflow B remains unchanged.

### Delivery contract
- Polls every 5 minutes in `Australia/Melbourne` time.
- Reads active users from the `user` tab and joins phone numbers to generated delivery nudges by `user_id`.
- Sends only `schd_` rows with `status=approved` whose scheduled time falls in the current 5-minute window. Source review rows are never delivered.
- Marks a nudge sent after Twilio accepts it and stores the Twilio Message SID in `schedule_state.wa_message_id`.

### Two delivery modes, chosen per nudge by the clinician
| `followup_enabled` | Template | Buttons | `schedule_state.status` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FALSE` (default) | `TWILIO_CONTENT_SID` | Done · In progress · Not yet | `sent` |
| `TRUE` | `TWILIO_COMMITMENT_CONTENT_SID` | Yes · No | `awaiting_commitment` |

The commitment template is only used on an **actionable** nudge (`reminder` or
`challenge`). An affirmation or reflection always falls back to the single-stage
template, so an informational message never asks for a commitment and never
schedules a follow-up.

When the commitment template is sent, this workflow also computes
`followup_due_at = sent_at + followup_delay_hours` and snapshots
`followup_enabled` / `followup_delay_hours` onto `schedule_state`. The snapshot
is deliberate: re-planning the weekly slot later must not change what an
already-delivered message asked. Workflow F sends the outcome check; nothing here
does.

### Required environment variables
`GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`, `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`, `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN`, `TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM`, `TWILIO_CONTENT_SID`, `TWILIO_COMMITMENT_CONTENT_SID`.

`TWILIO_COMMITMENT_CONTENT_SID` is a placeholder until the Yes/No quick-reply
Content Template is created in the Twilio console — see
`docs/TWILIO_CONTENT_TEMPLATES.md`. Until it is set, two-stage nudges fail loudly
rather than silently downgrading to the single-stage prompt.

### Safety
The narrow delivery window prevents activation from flushing old approved rows. Content Templates may be tested in-session in Sandbox but must be WhatsApp-approved before production-initiated delivery outside the 24-hour window.
